title: Move-In Trip Miles by Pickup Lead, Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Free Move-In
content:
**Move-in trip clause.** On a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental free move-in claim, the move-in trip miles depend on the calendar days from the actual pickup date of the truck to the claimed storage unit's move-in date, as the move-in date stands on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement:

- a pickup on the move-in date itself adds **15** miles;
- a pickup one to **3** days before the move-in date adds **10** miles for each of those days, counted as the calendar days from the pickup date to the move-in date;
- any other pickup adds no miles.

## Lead table (hypothetical claimed unit moving in on 10 March)

| Actual pickup date | Calendar days from pickup to move-in | Move-in trip miles |
|---|---|---|
| 6 March | 4 | 0 — more than 3 days before |
| 7 March | 3 | 30 |
| 8 March | 2 | 20 |
| 9 March | 1 | 10 |
| 10 March | 0 | 15 |
| 11 March | Pickup after the move-in date | 0 |

The miles grow with the lead from one to three days before the move-in date and stop at four days; a pickup after the move-in date adds nothing.
